title: Other user profiles on this Mac
whyItMatters: Other accounts have their own home folders under /Users. The machine may hold data belonging to people other than the person handing it over.
source: SPEC.md platform roots: USERS = /Users; other profiles are reported by directory name only (path jail rule 6)
notes: Names only. excludeHome drops the current account; no recursion into any profile, and no symlink is followed.

cleanup.exportFirst: Have each other person copy their files off first, to an external drive or their own new computer.
steps: Look at the account names in the plan and decide which people still need their accounts.
In System Settings > Users & Groups, click the info button next to an account and choose Delete User.
In the dialog, delete the home folder rather than saving a disk image that keeps their data.
cleanup.risk: That person's files and settings are deleted; the disk image option instead leaves their data on this Mac.
cleanup.source: Apple Support, Delete a user or group on Mac: https://support.apple.com/guide/mac-help/delete-a-user-or-group-mchlp1557/mac
